verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਚੰਦੁ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਆ ਦੇਹਿਧਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: raamacha(n)dh kaaran karan kaaran vas hoaa dhehidhaaree|

en.bdb: Due to some reason, Lord, the cause of all the causes assumed the form of Ramchandr.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੰਨਿ ਮਤੇਈ ਆਗਿਆ ਲੈ ਵਣਵਾਸੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਚਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: ma(n)n mateiee aagiaa lai vanavaas vaddaiee chaaree|

en.bdb: Accepting the orders of his step mother he went in exile and earned greatness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਸਰਾਮੁ ਦਾ ਬਲੁ ਹਰੈ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਗਰਬ ਪਰਹਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: parasaraam dhaa bal harai dheen dhiaal garab parahaaree|

en.bdb: Compassionate for the poor and decimator of the proud ones Ram effaced the power and pride of Pars'u Ram.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਾ ਲਖਮਣ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਿ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: seetaa lakhaman sev kar jatee satee sevaa hitakaaree|

en.bdb: Serving Warn, Laksaman became yati, the subduer of all passions and Sits also with all the virtues of a sati, remained totally devoted to Ram and served him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾਇਣੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: raamain varataiaa raam raaj kar sirasaT udhaaree|

en.bdb: Ramayan spread far and wide as the story establishing Ram-Rajy, a virtuous kingdom.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਮੁਣਸਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: maran munasaa sach hai saadhasa(n)gat mil paij savaaree|

en.bdb: Ram had liberated the whole world. Death for them is a truth who, having come to the holy congregation, have fulfilled their commitment to life.
Benevolence is the perfect teaching of the Guru.
